notes: 2026-08-02 nightly: FIRST REAL LIVE EVIDENCE. Three trades closed in 24h, taking live n from 1 to 4, and the ratchet -- the code path 07-30 established carries 100% of S2's edge and which had never executed live -- fired twice and worked correctly both times (AVAX locked +1R at $6.2034 -> exit +15.67% lev, rr 0.993; ETH locked +1R at $1852.08 -> exit +17.38% lev, rr 0.985). TP cancelled cleanly on both, no 'position UNPROTECTED' line, the 07-30 naked-stop fix never had to trigger. Live: 4 trades, 2W/2L, -6.14% cumulative leveraged, maxDD 2.77% of account. CHANGE APPLIED (S2, in strategy2.py): TRAIL_START_R 1.0 -> 0.75. Reasoning: 07-31 found the ADX gate's justification was void Heikin-Ashi numbers; the SAME void numbers (+628.5%/+1358.6%/maxDD -4.23%/8-of-8 months) justified the ratchet's own two constants, and nobody had re-derived them. Re-derived in portfolio2 (capped book, real prices, fees, 20 coins, 5000 bars): start=0.75 n=118 WR 55.9% net +33.73% maxDD -9.02% EV +0.286% t=2.28, against deployed start=1.0 n=117 WR 49.6% net +32.41% maxDD -12.49% EV +0.277% t=2.04. Net return barely moves; the gain is risk profile -- win rate +6.3pp and max drawdown ~28% smaller. Mechanism: 18 of 118 trades (15.3%) peak between 0.5R and 1.0R and under a 1.0 trigger every one is a maximum loss; arming below the take-profit converts them, at the cost of capping trades that peak near 1.0R at 0.75R instead of 1.00R. Both live losers sit exactly in that band (ARB MFE 0.61R, ETH MFE 0.87R, both full stops) -- consistent with the mechanism, but n=2 did not drive the decision, the n=118 sim did. Passed every standing rejection test: beats 1.0 at concurrency cap 1, 2 AND 4; beats it under alphabetical instead of |stretch| selection; and the 0.65-0.85 band is flat (net +33.7 to +36.7, t 2.24-2.43) so 0.75 was chosen as a round number in the plateau interior rather than the peak (0.70) which would be fitting noise. Honest caveats: 4-of-7 positive months vs 1.0's 5-of-7 (Feb +0.9% -> -0.1%, zero either way) and still tail-dependent. TRAIL_STEP_R deliberately NOT changed -- smaller is monotonically better with no plateau, so the optimum is at the boundary, which is a mechanical relationship not an edge, and chasing it adds stop-modification calls on the exact path whose failure mode was fixed 07-30. Also corrected the MAX_ADX and TP_R comment blocks in strategy2.py, which still quoted void HA numbers as settled fact -- TP_R's basis is now explicitly flagged as unvalidated and is the next thing to re-derive. test_ratchet.py updated to derive its arming cases from the constants instead of hard-coding 1.0, plus a new assertion that a sub-TP peak now leaves a profitable stop; 10/10 pass. NOT CHANGED: MAX_ADX stays 25 (07-31's finding that it buys no EV still stands and is still Mr G's call, not a nightly auto-tune), RSI 25/75, stretch 1.5, TP_R 1.0, MAX_TRADES 2, risk 1%, watchlist. NOTE on published %: leveraged % is distorted by the exchange leverage clamp -- ETH signal computed 15.9x, exchange gave 20x, so a 1R stop printed -26.1% instead of the intended -20%. Account risk was correct at ~1% throughout (size = risk_usd / stop distance), so this is a reporting artifact, not a capital-risk bug, but it makes the channel's headline number noisy. Flagged for Mr G. Every field in this file other than these notes still belongs to the DISABLED S1 engine.
